summary: Retest after fix of duplicate 'images' kwarg in admin_create_product and addition of try/catch + formError in AdminDashboard.saveProduct. Backend pytest: 20/20 PASS (was 19/20). Critical bug from iteration_1 (POST /api/admin/products 500) is RESOLVED. Frontend admin product CRUD UI flow end-to-end works: login -> /admin -> Nuevo producto modal -> Crear -> Editar -> Borrar, no Uncaught runtime error overlay, product count moves 19 -> 20 -> 19. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present with admin credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_create_product fix is clean: build dict from p.model_dump(), override slug and images, then unpack into Product(**data). No regressions in other admin endpoints.
AdminDashboard.saveProduct now has try/catch with formError; consider also surfacing a toast for success/failure for better UX (currently only inline error message).
Still using deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') in server.py; non-blocking but should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
data-testid naming inconsistencies noted in iteration_1 (filter-* vs category-pill-*, rc-* vs reprocann-*) remain — purely cosmetic / contract alignment.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created and then deleted a transient 'TEST_AUTO_UI_v2' product so no residual data. pytest also fully cleans up its TEST_ products via the CRUD lifecycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at /app/backend/tests/test_growshop_api.py has 20 tests covering health, products (list/filter/search/featured/slug/404), orders (demo checkout + empty cart 400 + 404), reprocann (submit + 422), admin (login invalid, orders/reprocann auth, full product CRUD, create-without-token 401), and auth/me 401. All passing. UI testids confirmed working: admin-login-email/password/submit, admin-add-product, prod-form-{name,desc,price,stock,cat,image,submit}, admin-edit-{id}, admin-delete-{id}. MercadoPago remains in DEMO MODE (mocked).
rca of the issue: Iteration_1 bug RCA: Product(slug=..., images=..., **p.model_dump()) raised TypeError because model_dump() already contained 'images'. Fix applied at server.py:506 — build data dict first, then override data['slug'] and data['images'], then Product(**data). Verified by pytest test_product_crud_lifecycle (200 OK on create) and by Playwright UI E2E. No further action required.
